name: Scheduler
whenToUse: Events placed in time: maintenance windows, bookings, shifts, release plans.
Rescheduling by drag (`onEventChange`) and creating from an empty slot (`onSlotClick`).

whenNotToUse.text: Picking a date or a range
Work by stage, not by time

anatomy.description: Today, previous / next, the visible range, view switch.
day / week time grid with an all-day row and a “now” line; month grid with “+N more”. On phones the week is a list of days.
title and time; `tone` for its kind; `locked` can’t be moved.

do.caption: Tone marks the kind of event: risky work warning, a release success.

dont.caption: Danger for a planning meeting: color stops meaning anything.

a11y: Events are buttons named with title and time; the visible range is announced when it changes.
Drag isn’t the only way: clicking an event should open an editor with date and time fields.
On phones the week is a list: seven time columns would make each event a few pixels wide, under the 24px target size (WCAG 2.5.8).
Set `locale` and `weekStartsOn` for the user, not the server.
Tone is never the only signal — say the kind in the title or details.

props.name: date
props.description: The date the visible range is built around.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Starting view when `view` isn't controlled. Unset: `day` on phones (below 640px), `week` elsewhere.

props.name: hourHeight
props.description: Pixel height of one hour in week/day view.

props.name: maxEventsPerDay
props.description: Month view: chips per day before "+N more".

props.name: now
props.description: Fixed "now" for stories/tests; defaults to the real clock.

props.name: onEventChange
props.type: ((event: SchedulerEvent, next: { start: Date; end: Date; }) => void)
props.description: Drag/resize finished. Omit to make events read-only.

props.name: onSlotClick
props.type: ((range: { start: Date; end: Date; allDay: boolean; }) => void)
props.description: Empty slot clicked: a 1-hour range in week/day view, a whole day in month view.

props.name: scrollToHour
props.description: Hour the time grid scrolls to on open.
